I'm a backend developer who enjoys exploring new technologies and turning ideas into working systems. I like designing backend architectures, experimenting with new tools, and continuously improving how systems are built and deployed. Most of my work starts from curiosity and ends up as something functional and practical.

I work mainly with **ASP.NET Core** and **SQL Server**, building RESTful APIs on clean, layered architectures — and I keep picking up new languages and tooling along the way.

Outside of coding, I enjoy playing games and connecting with people. I value collaboration, clear communication, and learning from different perspectives.
